name: shipyard
description: The multi-seat development pattern as a plugin: long-lived lead and reviewer seats with short-lived implementers between them. This slice ships the reviewer seat, which owns every fresh review and re-check in a repository and posts one parseable verdict per head.

goal_tokens.title: Context goal (tokens)
goal_tokens.description: The context a seat means to stay under, the same number the compaction mod judges a request against. A seat hands off and writes its resume file before this, not after.

scratch_root.title: Scratch worktree root
scratch_root.description: Where a seat cuts the throwaway worktrees it reviews in. A property of this machine's filesystem layout, not of any repository, so it belongs here rather than in a repository's config file.
